proposed.explanation: The investor has no existing holdings and 30,000 EGP in cash. The latest ABUK report provides a nine‑month basic EPS (verified) of 8.74 EGP for the period ending 30 September 2026 (evidence_id ABUK-ABUK_9M2026_results-p2-31). Annualising this figure (8.74 × 12/9) gives an estimated full‑year 2026 EPS of about 11.65 EGP. Using the cutoff price of 76.21 EGP per share, the implied price‑to‑earnings ratio is roughly 76.21 / 11.65 ≈ 6.5. This P/E is low compared with typical Egyptian exporter valuations, suggesting the share may be undervalued given the company’s export‑driven growth profile and the investor’s medium risk tolerance. The recommendation is to use the available cash to purchase 393 shares (cost 393 × 76.21 = 29,951 EGP), leaving a small cash buffer.  Unused figures: the revenue rows (ABUK‑ABUK_9M2026_results-p2-01, p2-02, p2-25, p2-26) are marked AMBIGUOUS and were not used in the EPS or P/E calculation; the nine‑month EPS figure is verified, so the main conclusion (low P/E, buy) is not affected by那些
